dialog.title: Pair reader
dialog.insecureWarning: This page is not served over HTTPS. Someone who controls the network could show you a fake code. Use HTTPS or a trusted network to pair.
dialog.chooseMode: What should happen with this reader?

mode.repair: Re-pair an existing reader (same device, new key)
mode.replace: Replace an existing reader (new device takes over)

dialog.connectionLost: Connection to the server lost. The status shown here may be out of date.
dialog.compare: Compare this code with the code on the reader
dialog.colourHint: Segment 1 blinks on the reader to mark the start.
dialog.readerWaiting: Waiting for confirmation at the reader
dialog.failed: Pairing failed. Start again to get a new code.
dialog.expired: Pairing timed out. Start again to get a new code.

reason.cancelled-at-reader: It was cancelled at the reader.
reason.cancelled-by-admin: It was cancelled in the admin interface.
reason.reader-disconnected: The reader disconnected before pairing finished.
reason.protocol: The reader sent an invalid pairing message.
reason.expired: Not both sides confirmed within 5 minutes.
reason.internal: An error occurred on the server.

security.title: Security
security.immediateHint: These actions take effect immediately. You do not need to save.
security.noCandidate: No device is waiting to pair. Reset the pairing on the device (or revoke it first) and wait until it appears under Not paired in the reader list, then try again.

chooseDevice.description: Choose the device that should take over this record. Each device shows its type, its key and when it announced itself.

security.unpairedHint: This reader still signs in with its token. Pair it from the reader list to give it its own key and an encrypted connection.
security.revokeMessage: The reader loses its key. Its live connection ends within a second and it will show up under Not paired in the reader list. It cannot sign in with a token any more.
security.repairDescription: Same device, new key. Use this after the pairing was reset on the device. The current key stops working.
security.replaceDescription: A different device takes over this reader's name, resources and settings, for example after swapping broken hardware. The old device is locked out.
security.revokeDescription: Locks this reader out right away. It stays in the list and can be paired again later.

toPair.title: Not paired
toPair.description: These readers do not have their own key yet. Pair them to encrypt their connection. The reader must be online.
toPair.requestFailed: Could not ask the reader to pair
toPair.notConnected: The reader is not connected right now. Pairing needs the reader to be online.
toPair.noResponse: The reader did not start pairing. Check that it is online and runs firmware that supports pairing, then try again.
